name: threadly
description: Social Media Master - JOE WHYTE SKILL. Connect Claude to Threadly's social media MCP server: schedule and publish posts, pull cross-platform analytics, generate captions and hashtags, plan content calendars, and monitor mentions — plus a skill for running a weekly social workflow. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to Threadly (threadlyhq.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

THREADLY_API_KEY.title: Threadly API key
THREADLY_API_KEY.description: Generate one in Threadly under Settings → API. Used as a Bearer token for https://threadlyhq.com/api/mcp.
